tuning_key.text: Into the unknown, dodging all the stones
tuning_key.attribution: Chords of Truth — Lucid Principles Canon (CC BY 4.0)

context_block: The stones are real — the obstacles, the unknowns, the places where the map ends. Courage isn't the absence of them; it's the decision to move through anyway, trusting that forward motion itself is a form of knowing. Today, whatever path dissolves in front of you, the frequency asks: can you stay hot, stay alive, stay *moving* even when you can't see the next step? That's where the real broadcast happens.

practice.title: Ground the Drive
practice.instruction: Place your feet firmly on the ground (or hands on your thighs if sitting) and feel the weight of your body pressing down — this is your anchor, your stones beneath you, solid and real.

practice.title: Breathe Into Forward
practice.instruction: Inhale for a count of 4, hold for 2, then exhale with intention — each breath is a small act of momentum, a choice to keep moving even in uncertainty.

practice.title: Echo the Frequency
practice.instruction: Listen to the COURAGE echo audio now, and as it plays, let your body sway or shift slightly — small movements — embodying the motion through the scatter, the dodging, the forward momentum that needs no map.
